metadata.description: Memory lifecycle management for Claude Code agents — not another storage layer, but the architecture on top of storage.

plugins.name: memoir
plugins.description: Built-in memory saves facts. memoir decides which facts deserve to become permanent. Hot/cold layering, two-axis importance x recency evaluation, a five-state lifecycle (seedling to archived), and a session-close digest workflow that maintains memory on its own. Extracted from 1.5 months of running a real memory system every day, not designed in a vacuum.
